name: wire-managed-backend-services
job: Wire managed backend capabilities via maintained BaaS candidates with auth, quota, and behavioral-proof honesty.

inScope: Authenticating on the correct management or runtime plane
Wiring one capability end-to-end with write-then-read proof
outOfScope: Unmaintained free MCP backend plugins as production authority
Routing production secrets through ephemeral paste hosts

inputs: Required capabilities: auth, KV, storage, email, realtime, sandbox, flags
BaaS candidate matrix and quota classes
outputs: End-to-end behavioral proof per wired capability
Gaps: unshipped services, plan limits, missing tokens
failureSemantics: Preview or unshipped services fail closed and are never faked; every wired capability needs a real postcondition proof (object exists, session issued, sandbox exec returns, email accepted, flag evaluates).

outcome.observable: Managed backend capabilities wired end-to-end with documented auth planes and at least one behavioral proof per capability, plus an honest gap list for unshipped services, plan limits, or missing tokens.
